title: Number & Measure — 3, 7, 10, 12, 33, 40, 42, 66/666, 144 and 144,000
status: mathematics + text history + anatomy + project numerology boundary atlas
purpose: Make every recurring project number declare what kind of number it is before symbolic comparison: mathematical property, geometric measure, textual count, manuscript reading, body count, historical convention or Potatoverse interpretation.
master_rule: Numerical equality is an edge, not an explanation. Two things sharing 12, 33, 42, 144 or 666 do not become historically related without evidence.

numbers.boundary: Trinity language is theological/project structure; not every threefold system is the same triad.

historical_neighbors: seven-line structure around Ana b'Koach reception
numbers.boundary: Seven is widespread and should not be used as unique provenance evidence.

numbers.geometry: regular decagon exterior turn 36°, interior angle 144°, total interior angle sum 1440°
numbers.boundary: The decagon is 2D cyclic geometry; sefirot are not a decagon unless a specific drawing chooses that form.
Twelvefold systems from different cultures need not share origin.

numbers.anatomy: Adults typically have 33 vertebrae: 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral and about 4 coccygeal, with lower segments fused.
numbers.boundary: 33 vertebrae do not prove 33 spiritual levels; Scottish Rite 33° is a different institutional numbering system.

numbers.scholarly_note: Biblical scholarship often treats forty as a conventional/full period in literary contexts rather than a universal secret code.
numbers.boundary: Do not convert every historical forty into exact numerological causation.

historical_neighbors: Ana b'Koach: 42 words in seven lines of six
42 wilderness encampments in later Jewish interpretive linkage
numbers.boundary: The project's roughly 42T karmic ledger is not historically derived from Ana b'Koach unless primary evidence shows influence.

project_roles: appears in later Timic physics/symbolic mappings
numbers.boundary: Do not treat 66 as a standard biblical or Kabbalistic master-number merely because 666 is prominent.

numbers.textual_fact: Revelation 13:18 gives the beast's number as 666 in the dominant textual tradition; 616 is an ancient variant attested in manuscripts and already known in antiquity.
numbers.cube_correction: A cube has 6 square faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Therefore '666 is the cube because 6 faces/6 triangles/6 points' is project numerology, not exact cube geometry.
numbers.boundary: Saturn/cube/666 linkage is a modern project/esoteric synthesis, not a single ancient doctrine.

math: regular decagon total interior angle sum=1440°
numbers.textual_neighbor: Revelation 21 gives the city wall measurement as 144 cubits.
numbers.boundary: The shared number alone does not prove Revelation encodes decagonal geometry.

numbers.textual_neighbor: Revelation 7 enumerates 12,000 from each of twelve tribes; Revelation 14 places 144,000 with the Lamb on Zion.
numbers.scholarly_note: Interpretation is contested; recent scholarship continues to debate the relation between the 144,000 and the innumerable multitude.
numbers.boundary: Not a modern census key or automatic numerical prophecy.

measure_types: textual/gematric value — letters/names mapped to numbers
symbolic project token — internally assigned meaning
cross_system_rules: Cube, decagon and dodecahedron must keep dimensional/type differences.
Body counts are empirical anatomy, not automatic spiritual rungs.
Biblical/apocalyptic numbers retain textual context before project mapping.
Manuscript variants belong in the number record when they materially affect interpretation.
Assistant-generated arithmetic/geometric relations should be labeled as later formalization when not directly user-authored.
